note: MiniBooNE ν̄μ CCQE cross sections in antineutrino-mode beam (10.1e20 POT): total flux-integrated σ vs reconstructed E_ν^QE,RFG, and single-differential dσ/dQ²_QE, each reported both on mineral oil (CH2, including the free-proton/hydrogen scattering component) and on carbon-12 (with the hydrogen CCQE component subtracted, RFG model with M_A=1.026 GeV). The paper's headline result — the (T_μ, cosθ_μ) double-differential cross section — is 2D and excluded from these 1D CSVs (see caveats). Target: per proton target (paper eq. for dσ²/dTμd[cosθμ], line ~479: "N the number of proton targets in the volume studied"; text at appendix intro, line ~1338: "these measurements are normalized to the total number of proton targets in the detector"). For the CH2/mineral-oil results this is free H protons + bound-in-carbon protons combined; for the "on carbon" results the free-hydrogen CCQE component has been statistically subtracted, so normalization is to bound protons in ¹²C only. Figure captions loosely call these "per-nucleon" but the paper's own equations and appendix text are explicit that N = proton targets, not all nucleons — I used "per proton" as the precise label.. No covariance is published (per-bin total uncertainty only).
